title: Reliability-Aware Probabilistic Fusion for Multimodal Learning with Incomplete Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.29621v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal inputs may be missing or degraded, raising distinct questions of evidence availability and trust. We introduce a reliability-aware Gaussian Product-of-Experts (PoE) in which an input-dependent reliability weight tempers each modality's latent precision, while missing experts are omitted. We characterize how reliability and availability affect posterior information and expert influence. Across two clinical multimodal tasks, the full framework remains competitive with complete inputs and achieves its clearest mean-AUROC advantage under modality absence, particularly on HAIM-MIMIC-MM. Ablations show a substantial gain from missing-aware training and an additional HAIM improvement from reliability weighting under matched PoE, missing-aware, and consistency training. Unseen test-time corruptions are used diagnostically and reveal modality-dependent reliability-weight and latent-uncertainty responses, including failure under severe

translated_title: 面向不完整证据的多模态学习可靠性感知概率融合
translated_abstract: 多模态输入可能出现缺失或退化，这引发了关于证据可用性与可信度的不同问题。我们提出了一种可靠性感知的高斯乘积专家方法，其中输入相关的可靠性权重可以调节每个模态的潜在精度，同时忽略缺失的专家。我们刻画了可靠性和可用性如何影响后验信息与专家影响力。在两个临床多模态任务上，完整框架在输入完整时保持竞争力，并在模态缺失的情况下取得了最明显的平均AUROC优势，尤其是在HAIM-MIMIC-MM数据集上。消融实验表明缺失感知训练带来了显著提升，并且在匹配的PoE、缺失感知和一致性训练条件下，可靠性加权为HAIM带来了额外的改进。未见过的测试时损坏被用于诊断性评估，揭示了模态依赖的可靠性权重和潜在不确定性响应，包括在严重情况下出现的失效。
tldr: 该论文提出一种可靠性感知的高斯乘积专家方法，利用输入相关的可靠性权重调节各模态精度并自动忽略缺失专家，从而在模态缺失的临床多模态任务（如HAIM-MIMIC-MM）中取得明显的AUROC性能优势。
